title: Pilot: does the pstack principle fix-root-causes change Sonnet's pass rate on bug-fix tasks?
question: Does one pstack principle, delivered through the compiled craft mode skill, change the pass rate of Sonnet on two bug-fix tasks graded by hidden tests?

verdict.label: no-claim
verdict.text: DECISION for pstack/principle-fix-root-causes: untested  (exposure 5% < 90%: the with arm mostly never opened the unit; underpowered: CI [-0.300, +0.300] not inside +-0.25)

notes: n = 10 per arm per fixture, Sonnet at default effort, delivered through /craft, at most 2 concurrent runs. The with arm has the unit installed, the none arm has it disabled.
The with arm read the unit in 1 of 20 trials, so the run measures the unit on offer, not its content.
fixture_sha256 is the value that earlier runs of the same fixtures use. The pilot's own manifests list the same file hashes in a different sort order, so their hashes differ.
The pilot's primary grader is the same file as in the 2026-11-10 runs (grader_sha256 is equal).
